title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the acceptance of the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-27 Real Estate Fraud Prosecution (REFP) Program grant award from…
text:
[Council File 14-0955-S11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the acceptance of the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-27 Real Estate Fraud Prosecution (REFP) Program grant award from the County of Los Angeles (County).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. APPROVE and AUTHORIZE the Chief of Police, Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD), or designee, to:
a. Retroactively apply for and accept the FY 2026-27 REFP Program grant award, in the amount of $1,393,000, from the County, for the period of July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
b. Negotiate and execute any documents or agreements necessary to accept the grant, subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney as to form.
2. AUTHORIZE the LAPD to:
a. Spend up to $1,393,000 in funding in accordance with the grant award agreement.
b. Submit grant reimbursement requests to the grantor and deposit the FY 2026-27 REFP Program grant funds received under this agreement into the LAPD Grant Fund No. 339/70, account number to be determined (TBD).
c. Prepare Controller instructions for any technical adjustments as necessary to implement Mayor and Council intentions, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer (CAO); and, AUTHORIZE the Controller to implement the instructions.
3. AUTHORIZE the Controller to:
a. Establish a grant receivable and appropriate up to $1,393,000 within the LAPD Grant Fund No. 339/70, account number TBD, for the receipt and disbursement of the FY 2026-27 REFP Program grant funds.
b. Increase appropriations and transfer, as necessary, from FY 2026-27 REFP Program grant funds, Fund No. 339/70, account number TBD, to Fund No. 100/70, account numbers and amounts as stated below:
i. Account No. 001012, Salaries Sworn: $681,502
ii. Account No. 001092, Overtime Sworn: $211,986
iii. Account No. TBD, Related Costs: $480,526
4. AUTHORIZE four Resolution Authority positions through June 30, 2027, as follows:
a. Two Police Detective I positions, Class Code 2223-1
b. One Police Detective II position, Class Code 2223-2
c. One Police Detective III position, Class Code 2223-3
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO reports that approval of the recommendations stated in the CAO report dated October 21, 2026 will authorize the LAPD to accept a grant award in the amount of $1,393,000 from the County for participation in the FY 2026-27 REFP Grant Program. There is no matching requirement associated with this grant award. There is no additional impact to the General Fund. Financial policies The CAO reports that the recommendations provided in said report comply with the statement City’s Financial Policies in that one-time grant funding will be utilized for one-time program expenditures.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Personnel and Hiring Committee and Public Safety Committee have waived consideration of this matter.)
